title: 第7章 人死了，幸存值没花了-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》
content:
第(1/3)页

    腥风扑面。

    许默瞳孔中，那团灰褐色急速放大。

    没有尖叫，没有腿软。

    此时此刻，恐慌是最廉价的。

    许默的视线疯狂扫掠，瞬间死死钉在右侧三米外一棵枯死的老树上。

    没有任何犹豫。

    他猛地一蹬地面，整个人贴地窜出，一个狼狈却极度粗暴的前滚翻，双手死死抠住粗糙干裂的树干。

    手脚并用，指甲嵌进木刺里。

    唰唰两下！

    他拼了命地向上攀爬，在树干上蹬出刺耳的摩擦声。

    就在他双脚刚刚离地的刹那，那团裹挟着迷雾的巨大黑影轰然撞碎了他原本藏身的那片巨叶！

    地动山摇。

    浓烈的腐臭味混杂着令人作呕的血腥气，将整棵枯树笼罩。

    许默低头看去。

    迷雾翻滚间，一双猩红眼珠死死锁定着他。

    野兽一击扑空，前爪猛地刨开泥土，后肢狠狠一蹬，贴着树干拔地而起，直奔许默的脚踝咬来！

    森白的獠牙上甚至还挂着不知名生物的内脏碎块。

    来不及躲了。

    许默眼中闪过狠戾。

    他非但没有继续向上躲避，反而双手死死扒住树干借力，右腿肌肉骤然紧绷，带着全身的重量，对准那颗冲上来的狰狞头颅，狠狠一脚倒踹而下！

    去死！

    沉闷的肉体碰撞声在迷雾中炸响。

    这一脚结结实实地踹在了野兽的鼻梁上。

    巨大的冲击力直接将野兽体表萦绕的那层诡异迷雾生生震散！

    看清那东西真容的瞬间，许默的头皮瞬间过电一般发麻。

    那根本不是野兽！

    大片大片的灰褐色皮毛早已经剥落，露出下方高度腐败、流淌着黑黄脓液的暗红色烂肉。

    森白的肋骨刺穿了腹部的皮肉，随着它的动作，甚至能看到胸腔里一堆早已干瘪发黑、爬满蛆虫的脏器。

    活死人见多了，这是头活死兽！

    砰的一声闷响。

    怪物被踹得重重砸落地面，但它竟然连痛呼都没有发出一声。

    那颗被许默踹得几乎凹陷下去的头颅诡异地扭动了两下，伴随着令人牙酸的骨骼摩擦声，再次扬起！

    猩红的双眼彻底陷入狂暴。

    吼——！！！

    怪物四肢并用，锋利的爪子切入树干，发了疯似地再次向上攀爬。

    速度比刚才快了足足一倍！

    这特么铁是爬不赢！

    许默左手死死扣住树皮，右手猛地抽出腰间的精钢军刀。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The fishy wind blew against my face.

The gray-brown mass in Xu Mo's pupils expanded rapidly.

No screaming, no weak legs.

At this moment, panic is the cheapest.

Xu Mo's eyes swept wildly, and he was instantly fixed on an old dead tree three meters away on the right.

There was no hesitation.

He kicked off the ground suddenly and jumped out, rolling forward in an awkward but extremely rough manner, grabbing the rough and cracked tree trunk with both hands.

He used his hands and feet together and dug his nails into the wood thorns.

Swish, swish twice!

He climbed up with all his strength, making a harsh friction sound on the tree trunk.

The moment his feet just left the ground, the huge black shadow wrapped in mist crashed into the giant leaf where he was originally hiding!

The earth trembled and the mountains shook.

The strong putrid smell mixed with the disgusting smell of blood shrouded the entire dead tree.

Xu Mo looked down.

As the mist rolled in, a pair of scarlet eyes locked on him.

The beast jumped into the air with one blow, its front paws violently dug away at the soil, its hind legs kicked hard, it rose up against the tree trunk, and went straight to bite Xu Mo's ankle!

There were even fragments of the internal organs of an unknown creature hanging on Sen Bai’s fangs.

It’s too late to hide.

Xu Mo's eyes flashed with cruelty.

Instead of continuing to dodge upwards, he grabbed the tree trunk with both hands and used his strength. The muscles of his right leg suddenly tightened, and with the weight of his whole body, he aimed at the ferocious head that rushed up and kicked it down hard!

Go to hell!

The dull sound of flesh colliding exploded in the mist.

This kick landed firmly on the bridge of the beast's nose.

The huge impact directly shook away the strange layer of fog lingering on the beast's body!

The moment he saw the thing’s true appearance, Xu Mo’s scalp felt numb as if there was an electric shock.

That’s not a beast at all!

Large tracts of gray-brown fur have already peeled off, revealing the dark red rotten flesh underneath that is highly decayed and flowing with black and yellow pus.

Sen Bai’s ribs pierced the flesh of his abdomen, and with its movements, one could even see a pile of shriveled, blackened, maggot-covered organs in his chest.

We have seen too many living dead people, this is a living dead beast!

There was a muffled bang.

The monster was kicked hard and fell to the ground, but it didn't even cry out in pain.

The head that was almost dented by Xu Mo's kick twisted twice strangely, and then raised up again with the sound of bone grinding that made people feel sour!

The scarlet eyes were completely violent.

Roar——!!!

The monster used all four limbs, cut its sharp claws into the tree trunk, and climbed up again like crazy.

The speed is twice as fast as before!

There is no way you can win this damn thing!

Xu Mo clung to the bark of the tree with his left hand, and jerked out the stainless steel saber from his waist with his right hand.
